name: Explain molecular biology concepts and design experiments
description: Users sought detailed scientific explanations, theoretical mechanisms, and step-by-step experimental protocols for complex tasks in molecular biology, biochemistry, and genetics, including the design of PCR primers, antibody phage display libraries, protein engineering, and pathogen detection workflows. Many requests also involved troubleshooting specific laboratory techniques, such as enzyme optimization, microbial culture issues, or data analysis for high-throughput sequencing.
